town_description: Katamdag is a census town and community-development block area adjoining Hazaribagh city in Jharkhand, lying to the west of the city on the Hazaribagh–Barkagaon road. It is a mixed urban–rural settlement with small industries and residential colonies, and serves as a stopover for travellers heading to Barkagaon and the surrounding coal belt. Narsingh Sthan Temple, at Morangi nearby, is listed as its top-rated place to visit.
